basis: Lumbosacral vertebral closure defect with herniated spinal neural tissue; neurogenic bladder and bowel are secondary neurologic dysfunction, not direct urinary or intestinal injury.

decisions.renal: none: common neurogenic bladder reflects disrupted innervation; urinary tract damage is not intrinsic or established here.
decisions.gastrointestinal: none: neurogenic bowel reflects disrupted innervation rather than direct intestinal damage.

basis: Benign squamous neoplasm arising in the laryngeal airway; an HPV association does not independently classify this tumour as an infection.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: the concept defines a benign neoplasm associated with HPV, rather than an infection or immune-mediated disease.

basis: Sulfite metabolism defect causing destructive encephalopathy; ectopia lentis affects roughly half of surviving patients. Cerebral visual impairment is neurologic.

decisions.ocular: involved: characteristic ectopia lentis occurs in roughly half of surviving patients and directly disrupts ocular function.

basis: Brain/radial defects define syndrome; nasal aplasia and auditory canal atresia each 80-99%. Cap excludes defining cardiac/renal defects and ocular, oral and gallbladder anomalies.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: defining cardiac defects qualify, but the four-axis cap prioritizes brain, limbs and nasal/auditory atresia; specified cardiac lesions occur in 5-29%.
decisions.pulmonary: involved: nasal aplasia affects 80-99%, a permanent structural defect of the upper airway.
decisions.ocular: none: microphthalmia affects 30-79%, but is omitted under the cap in favor of more frequent nasal and auditory canal defects.

basis: Congenital titin myopathy is defined by muscle weakness, contractures and fractures, with cardiac abnormalities explicitly included in its defining spectrum.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: cardiac abnormalities are explicitly included in the disease definition, although variably expressed.

basis: Axonal peripheral sensorimotor neuropathy; distal weakness and amyotrophy result from denervation rather than a direct skeletal muscle disease process.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: common distal wasting is secondary to axonal denervation; direct muscle or skeletal pathology is not established.

basis: COA8-related respiratory-chain metabolic defect; cavitating leukodystrophy in 6/6 and regression in 5/6 establish neurologic damage. Muscle staining alone does not establish myopathy.

decisions.neurologic: involved: leukodystrophy occurs in 6/6, regression in 5/6 and neuropathy in 3/6; the concept itself is defined by the respiratory-chain metabolic defect.

basis: Marrow/red-cell disorder; skeletal anomalies ~50-60%, hearing loss 1/2, palatal clefts ~29-33%. Small denominators limit certainty; singleton autism does not establish a common phenotype.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: submucous cleft palate in 1/3 and cleft palate in 2/7 support an approximately 30% rate of permanent oral structural defects.
decisions.neurologic: none: autism and ADHD are singleton observations without a representative frequency; common intrinsic neurodevelopmental damage is not established.

basis: Organic aciduria with developmental/intellectual impairment in 30-79%. Cytopenias are typically reversible during crises; renal insufficiency is annotated 5-29%; hepatomegaly alone is insufficient.

decisions.haematologic: none: leukopenia is annotated 30-79%, but typically reflects reversible marrow suppression during metabolic crises rather than lasting haematologic damage.

basis: Intellectual disability, seizures, retinal and skin pigmentary disorders are explicitly definitional. Pigmentary findings are uncommon in HPO; recurrent infections alone do not prove immunodeficiency.

decisions.ocular: primary: retinal pigmentary disorder is explicitly included in the disease definition; the 5-29% annotation does not exclude a definitional primary organ.
decisions.dermatologic: primary: persistent skin pigmentation disorder is explicitly included in the disease definition, despite its low annotated frequency.
